{{main|1936 Copa del Presidente de la República}}
The '''1936 Copa del Presidente de la República final''' decided the winner of the [[1936 Copa del Presidente de la República]], the 36th staging of Spain's premier football cup, now known as the [[Copa del Rey]]. The final was the last one before the tournament was cancelled due to the [[Spanish Civil War]] until 1939, and therefore the last one under the "Copa del Predidente de la República" name.

In the match, held on 21 June at the [[Mestalla Stadium|Mestalla]] in [[Valencia]], [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] (then known as "Madrid FC" for political reasons) defeated [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]] 2-1 in the first ''[[El Clásico]]'' final. It was Real Madrid's 7th title in their 15th final, while Barcelona appeared for the 16th time and were denied their 13th title.<ref>{{cite web|title=Spain - List of Cup Finals|website=[[RSSSF]]|url=https://www.rsssf.org/tabless/spancuphist.html|access-date=18 April 2014}}</ref>

The match is remembered for the "impossible save" by Madrid goalkeeper [[Ricardo Zamora]], which denied Barcelona's [[Josep Escolà]] from scoring a last-minute equaliser. This is the most remembered save in the history of Spanish football.<ref>{{cite web|title=Spain - Cup 1936|website=[[RSSSF]]|url=https://www.rsssf.org/tabless/spancup1936.html|access-date=18 April 2014}}</ref>
